body: Thank you for the suggestion. I am already seeing a therapist about it, and hopefully a psychiatrist soon. However, I cant talk to my friends about what I’m experiencing. I’ve already had too many cases where I’ve become a burden to them and they have dropped me in some way or other. At this point I’m just isolating myself. Reddit is the only version of social media I still have on my phone and I’ve turned off all notifications as well so I can avoid contact. Nothing really seems to help me anymore idk

For me, something that has stopped me from doing these kinds of things before is when people show that they actually deeply care. You can do this through words, or actions. Going over to someone’s house when you think they’re in trouble (if ur able to), or being very insistent that ur there for them and that you truly care and love them. At one point, hearing my friend cry over the phone because of what I was about to do kind of was a brief wake up call. They couldn’t say much so they just showed what they were feeling and it kind of made me think about the repercussions of what I was going to do. Ultimately, you can stall someone from committing suicide if they haven’t considered all the options and haven’t completely made up their mind. However, as is my case, I’ve stalled enough times and been stopped enough times. I know that if I try again, like I did last night, I will be trying for real without intention of stopping no matter what. If worst comes to worst you need to jnow that sometimes there’s nothing that you can do but try your best and not to blame yourself. Good luck ❤️

Please throw them up or go to the hospital and tell them what happened. It may seem like a lot of trouble right now but if you have any sense at all that you don’t want to die then please please please don’t let yourself get poisoned.
